section.title: org.osgi.service.jakartars.runtime.dto
section.para: Jakarta RESTful Web Services Runtime DTO Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: ApplicationDTO - Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Application service.
BaseApplicationDTO - Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services application service.
BaseDTO - Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services service.
BaseExtensionDTO - Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension service.
DTOConstants - Defines standard constants for the DTOs.
ExtensionDTO - Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Extension service currently being hosted by the JakartarsServiceRuntime
FailedApplicationDTO - Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services service which is currently not being used due to a problem.
FailedExtensionDTO - Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Extension service which is currently not being used due to a problem.
FailedResourceDTO - Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource service which is currently not being used due to a problem.
ResourceDTO - Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource service.
ResourceMethodInfoDTO - Represents information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource method.
RuntimeDTO - Represents the state of a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Service Runtime.

section.title: public class ApplicationDTO extends BaseApplicationDTO
section.para: Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Application service.

section.title: public ResourceMethodInfoDTO[] resourceMethods
section.para: The RequestPaths handled by statically defined resources in this Application

section.title: public abstract class BaseApplicationDTO extends BaseDTO
section.para: Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services application service.

section.title: public String base
section.para: The base URI of the resource defined by JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_APPLICATION_BASE.

section.title: public ExtensionDTO[] extensionDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the dynamic Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension services associated with this Application. The returned array may be empty if this application is currently not associated with any Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension services.

section.title: public ResourceDTO[] resourceDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the dynamic Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource services associated with this Application. The returned array may be empty if this application is currently not associated with any Jakarta RESTful Web Services Resource services.

section.title: public abstract class BaseDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services service.

section.title: public String name
section.para: The name of the service if it set one using JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_NAME, otherwise this value will contain the generated name for this service

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the Jakarta RESTful Web Services service

section.title: public abstract class BaseExtensionDTO extends BaseDTO
section.para: Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension service.

section.title: public String[] extensionTypes
section.para: The extension types recognized for this service.

section.title: public final class DTOConstants
section.para: Defines standard constants for the DTOs. The error codes are defined to take the same values as used by the Http Service Whiteboard

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_DUPLICATE_NAME = 6
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry with the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_NAME property and a service with that name already exists in the runtime

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_NOT_AN_EXTENSION_TYPE = 4
section.para: The extension service is registered in the service registry but the service is not registered using a recognized extension type

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_REQUIRED_APPLICATION_UNAVAILABLE = 7
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry with the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_APPLICATION_SELECT property and the filters is not matched by any running application.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_REQUIRED_EXTENSIONS_UNAVAILABLE = 5
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry with the JakartarsWhiteboardConstants.JAKARTA_RS_EXTENSION_SELECT property and one or more of the filters is not matched.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SERVICE_NOT_GETTABLE = 2
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry but getting the service fails as it returns null.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SHADOWED_BY_OTHER_SERVICE = 1
section.para: Service is shadowed by another service.
For example, another service with the same service properties but having a higher service ranking. See org.osgi.framework.ServiceReference.compareTo(Object).

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_UNKNOWN = 0
section.para: Failure reason is unknown.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_VALIDATION_FAILED = 3
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry but the service properties are invalid.

section.title: public class ExtensionDTO extends BaseExtensionDTO
section.para: Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Extension service currently being hosted by the JakartarsServiceRuntime

section.title: public String[] consumes
section.para: The media types consumed by this service, if provided in an Consumes annotation

section.title: public ResourceDTO[] filteredByName
section.para: The resourceDTOs that are mapped to this extension using a NameBinding annotation

section.title: public String[] nameBindings
section.para: The full names of the NameBinding annotations applied to this extension, if any

section.title: public String[] produces
section.para: The media types produced by this service, if provided in an Produces annotation

section.title: public class FailedApplicationDTO extends BaseApplicationDTO
section.para: Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services service which is currently not being used due to a problem.

The service represented by this DTO is not used due to a failure, but the BaseApplicationDTO.extensionDTOs and BaseApplicationDTO.resourceDTOs may be non-empty if whiteboard services have been associated with this failed application.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the resource represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedExtensionDTO extends BaseExtensionDTO
section.para: Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Extension service which is currently not being used due to a problem.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the extension represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedResourceDTO extends BaseDTO
section.para: Represents a Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource service which is currently not being used due to a problem.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the resource represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class ResourceDTO extends BaseDTO
section.para: Represents common information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource service.

section.title: public ResourceMethodInfoDTO[] resourceMethods
section.para: The RequestPaths handled by this resource

section.title: public class ResourceMethodInfoDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents information about a Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource method. All information is determined by reading the relevant annotations, from the Jakarta RESTful Web Services type and not interpreted further. Dynamic information, or information provided in other ways may not be represented in this DTO.

section.title: public String[] consumingMimeType
section.para: The mime-type(s) consumed by this resource method, null if Consumes is not defined

section.title: public String method
section.para: The HTTP verb being handled, for example GET, DELETE, PUT, POST, HEAD, OPTIONS, null if no HttpMethod is defined

section.title: public String[] nameBindings
section.para: The NameBinding annotations that apply to this resource method, if any

section.title: public String path
section.para: The path of this resource method. Placeholder information present in the URI pattern will not be interpreted and simply returned as defined.

section.title: public String[] producingMimeType
section.para: The mime-type(s) produced by this resource method, null if Produces is not defined

section.title: public class RuntimeDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents the state of a Jakarta RESTful Web Services Service Runtime.

section.title: public ApplicationDTO[] applicationDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the Jakarta RESTful Web Services Application services associated with this Runtime. The returned array may be empty if this whiteboard is currently not associated with any Jakarta RESTful Web Services application services.

section.title: public ApplicationDTO defaultApplication
section.para: Returns the current state of the default application for this Runtime.

section.title: public FailedApplicationDTO[] failedApplicationDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension services targeted to this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedExtensionDTO[] failedExtensionDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the Jakarta RESTful Web Services extension services targeted to this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedResourceDTO[] failedResourceDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the Jakarta RESTful Web Services resource services targeted to this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public ServiceReferenceDTO serviceDTO
section.para: The DTO for the corresponding JakartarsServiceRuntime. This value is never null.
